title: Optimizer Update Available
release_notes:
• Advanced performance upgrade: Eliminated Binder IPC bottlenecks with single-pass package activity scanning and batch RAM mapping
• Full GPU hardware acceleration and largeHeap memory optimization enabled
• Optimized RecyclerView view caching and diffing to eliminate list lag and stutter
• In Android Info: Removed secondary title and refresh button for a cleaner, unified diagnostics layout
• Reduced redundant view layout invalidations and AppBarLayout scroll disruptions
